identity.title: Deterministic Qualification Candidate Packet and WP170 Crossing Contract
identity.objective: Implement the deterministic local/offline S10-QUAL-01 crossing substrate: one immutable content-addressed QualificationCandidate built only from a verified current supportive Alpha lineage, a canonical AF1_PASS receipt, verified ResearchProvenanceManifest inputs, frozen hypothesis/feature/label/dataset-split/sample-power/test-family plans, conditional B0/B1/B2 forecast evaluation semantics, and execution-feasibility evidence states. The packet is advisory and explicitly non-qualifying; S10-GATE-QUAL-01 remains the separate acceptance gate and WP170 remains the preregistration/OOS experiment authority. No network, Hermes, wallet gate invention, economics, strategy, paper, execution, live or Gate-C authority.

scope.rollback_surface: Revert S10-QUAL-01. The additive qualification.py module, package exports, focused tests, qualification contract/status/spec artifacts and bounded roadmap/status compatibility edits disappear. Existing AF1 evidence, Alpha Factory/discovery registries, common provenance, WP170 experiment OS/registry, WALLET, Hermes, PIT, dependencies, workflows and all paper/execution/live surfaces remain unchanged. No qualification registry, runtime workspace, network state, experiment, OOS exposure, economic result, order or capital exists to unwind.

api_matrix.reason: S10-QUAL-01 adds one deterministic qualification-packet API and package-root exports while consuming existing Alpha, AF1, provenance and WP170 constants read-only.

items.compatibility_requirement: No new registry, filesystem writer, clock, randomness, network, Hermes/provider, wallet-runtime, WP170 mutation or execution path.

items.after: Only the frozen S10-QUAL-01 public constants/types/functions are exported.
items.compatibility_requirement: All existing exports and signatures remain unchanged; experiment_os.py and experiment_registry.py are untouched.

items.before: WP170 owns hypothesis/dataset/split/metric/baseline/family/preregistration/OOS contracts but has no S10-QUAL packet input.

items.compatibility_requirement: Do not modify or wrap WP170 builders/registry and do not create a PreregisteredExperiment or expose OOS.

semantic_fields.reason: These fields close the qualification crossing semantics without implementing the later gate or experiment.

items.required_rule: QualificationCandidate uses schema polymarket-qualification-candidate/1.0.0 and qualificationcandidate:sha256: over canonical normalized fields excluding only qualification_candidate_id.
items.validation_rule: Roundtrip validation re-derives the exact identity; binary floats, unknown fields, noncanonical nested JSON and authority-flag changes reject.
items.safe_output: bounded immutable candidate or closed error code

items.required_rule: Bind alpha registry head plus exact OpportunityCandidate, HypothesisFamily and unique current ResearchEpisode leaf; leaf must equal caller-selected governing id and be RESEARCH_SUPPORTIVE.
items.validation_rule: Missing/ambiguous/stale/mismatched/non-supportive lineage rejects; ALPHA-02 lane priority never grants qualification.

items.required_rule: Supplied AF1GateReceipt must pass existing validate_af1_record, have AF1_PASS and every AF1 dimension PASS, and preserve all three no-authority flags.
items.validation_rule: Any non-PASS, malformed or authority-expanded receipt rejects; current merged receipt is predecessor evidence, not a universal hardcoded product constant.

items.required_rule: Bind sorted unique verified ResearchProvenanceManifest ids; all manifest cutoffs and governing research_as_of are <= candidate information_cutoff and all dataset snapshot refs in the split plan appear in the supplied manifest dataset_refs union.
items.validation_rule: Identity/cutoff/dataset-ref inconsistency rejects; DQ/replay limitations are never upgraded.

items.required_rule: Freeze the WP170 AlphaHypothesis-compatible research intent, with predecessor_candidate_ids derived later from alpha_candidate_id and human_review_state exactly REVIEWED.
items.validation_rule: Exact key set, bounded text/opaque fields and REVIEWED assertion only.

items.required_rule: Feature refs are qualification logical refs with source class PUBLIC_NON_MARKET, MARKET_PIT or TIME_ONLY and exact at-or-before-decision availability; label plan freezes target/horizon/outcome/availability/censoring semantics. These are not claimed to be current WP170 FeatureDefinition ids.
items.validation_rule: Feature/source/evidence maps have identical keysets; refs are unique; no future-information rule is exact; label evidence refs are sorted unique.
items.safe_output: canonical feature and label plan JSON

items.required_rule: Freeze PIT dataset refs, EXCLUSIVE leakage grouping, LEAKAGE_MARKET_RELATED_EXCLUSIVE event grouping, ordered formation/selection/OOS boundaries, WP170 purge rule, embargo, half-open inclusion and minimum samples per role.
items.validation_rule: formation < selection < oos < end; group_policy EXCLUSIVE; exact purge/inclusion/event-grouping literals; nonnegative embargo and positive minimum.

items.required_rule: Freeze analysis unit, available/required sample and independent-group counts, declared power method/reference, target power, significance level and minimum detectable effect as facts only.
items.validation_rule: Counts and canonical decimal domains validate; availability shortfall does not make the record structurally invalid and does not auto-qualify.

items.required_rule: Freeze research program, metric family, primary/secondary metrics, WP170 metric direction and correction policy, declared multiplicity method/family size, WP170-compatible primary threshold mapping and baseline acceptance rule.
items.validation_rule: SINGLETON requires family_size 1; FAMILY_TRIAL_COUNT requires >=1; threshold operator matches metric direction; baseline rule matches direction.

items.required_rule: GENERIC_METRIC requires exact NOT_APPLICABLE form. BINARY_PROBABILITY requires PIT_MARKET_PROBABILITY_V1 B0, independent-information B1, B2 equal to B1 plus explicit MARKET_PIT additions, identical OOS membership, Brier or log-loss proper score, calibration diagnostic and required B1-vs-B0/B2-vs-B0/B2-vs-B1 comparisons.
items.validation_rule: B1 cannot include MARKET_PIT refs; B2 additions must all be MARKET_PIT and exact union semantics hold; all required comparison booleans true; binary primary metric is LOWER_IS_BETTER.

items.required_rule: Exactly FEES, RESOLUTION_RULES, TICK_SIZE_MIN_ORDER, SPREAD_DEPTH, LATENCY and PARTIAL_FILL; each records AVAILABLE, PARTIAL, MISSING or NOT_APPLICABLE plus evidence refs only.
items.validation_rule: AVAILABLE/PARTIAL require evidence refs; MISSING/NOT_APPLICABLE require none; no expected return, PnL, sizing, slippage-adjusted edge or profitability fields exist.

items.required_rule: NON_WALLET is admitted in v1; WALLET_DEPENDENT fails closed with WALLET_GATE_REQUIRED until a real S10-GATE-WALLET-01 receipt contract exists.
items.validation_rule: No placeholder wallet receipt id/schema/prefix or arbitrary wallet evidence bypass is accepted.

items.required_rule: Every candidate is advisory_only, human_review_required, no_execution_authority, no_strategy_authority and no_qualification_authority exactly true.
items.validation_rule: Any false or omitted authority invariant rejects.
